title: OSWorld1
domain: Open-ended tasks on a real Ubuntu desktop and its applications, each in a VM of its own.
good_to_know: Original runs one of OSWorld's own agents, chosen by the Agent option (M3 by default), with a model it is published with.
Providers: OpenAI for OpenAI CUA; OpenAI-compatible for Muse Spark (Meta's API) and for EvoCUA, AutoGLM-OS and Mano (your model server); OpenRouter for the others.
Only M3, PromptAgent and Qwen-CUA have completed tasks through Nullius. The other agents were checked up to their first model call.
Each task's VM takes 4 cores and 4 GB of memory; OS-Symphony can start a second. Run no more tasks at once than the machine holds.
Prepare the machine before the first run (Docker, KVM, five system libraries, a VM image of about 25 GB): see OSWorld1 machine setup under Benchmarks in the documentation.
Scores depend on the machine's speed, because OSWorld waits a fixed time after each action. Compare runs made on similar machines.
OSWorld's infeasible tasks are listed publicly, and its scorer checks only the last action. An agent that looks a task up online and answers FAIL scores it.
upstream_limitations: OSWorld publishes no solutions: no reference run shows that each task can be solved.
The 8 Google Drive tasks need a Google account's credentials, which OSWorld does not ship. They are in All tasks, and 3 of them in Small.
49 tasks ask for a proxy whose credentials OSWorld does not ship; with PromptAgent, GPT-5.4, OpenAI CUA, OS-Symphony, EvoCUA or Muse Spark, those tasks fail or run offline.
The VM image is not pinned: a later download can differ from the one a score was made with.
Each VM's ports are open on every network interface; one runs any command in the VM. Bind Docker's ports to 127.0.0.1, or keep the machine off untrusted networks.
limitations: No agent from the Agents page can run it yet.
Only 12 of OSWorld's agents are offered; the others fail at the pinned commit or need services the relay cannot reach.
The VMs run only on Docker's default socket, not on rootless Docker or a Docker context. Podman is untested.
A task still running after 2 hours is stopped and gets no score.

datasets.title: OSWorld, Ubuntu tasks
datasets.verifier: OSWorld's own evaluator, DesktopEnv.evaluate: the task's evaluator functions on the VM's final state.
datasets.notes: 369 tasks in 10 domains; 361 without Google Drive. Apache-2.0.
